name: claudin
description: Live official docs for Claude Code, claude.ai/Cowork, the Claude API, MCP, OpenAI/Codex and xAI/Grok: six authless docs MCP servers plus docs-lookup (cited answers, nothing to build). For builders: plugin-dev (plugins across chat, Cowork, Claude Code, Codex/ChatGPT, Grok Build, Copilot CLI, Antigravity and Gemini CLI), mcp-dev (MCP servers, MCP Apps, OAuth, MCPB, directory review, spec 2026-07-28) and skill-creator-v2 (skill lifecycle: create, eval, benchmark, package, claude.ai compat).

interface.longDescription: Ask about Claude Code, claude.ai, the Claude API, MCP, OpenAI/Codex or xAI/Grok and docs-lookup answers from the live official docs, with links: six bundled docs MCP servers, no setup. For builders: plugin-dev packages skills, MCP servers and Claude Code extras into plugins for Claude chat, Cowork, Claude Code, Codex/ChatGPT, Grok Build, GitHub Copilot CLI, Google Antigravity and Gemini CLI; mcp-dev designs, tests and ships MCP servers and MCP Apps (deployment, tool design, OAuth, MCPB, directory review, the stateless 2026-07-28 spec, a stdlib probe script); skill-creator-v2 runs the skill lifecycle. Personal toolkit maintained by travnie; not an official Anthropic, OpenAI or xAI plugin.
